This text is part of the gSung 'bum of Phag mo gru pa (photocopy of an dbu can manuscript from China, the pagination of which corresponds exactly to that of the sDe dge blockprint), fols. 101a-181b.
Colophon, fol. 181a2-3: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rim gyis 'jug pa'i tshul dpal ldan phag mo gru pas mdzad pa rdzogs so.
name: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rim kyis 'jug pa'i tshul (1)
